basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old aviation enthusiast from Manchester, NH. During the day, I work as a graphic designer for a local marketing firm. I'm single and often stay up late, exploring various subreddits and engaging with online communities. I have a keen interest in video games, particularly GTA Online, and love discussing game mechanics with fellow gamers. During weekends, I enjoy watching anime and am currently exploring career opportunities in animation. I dislike overly negative discussions and prefer constructive conversations.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge heavily revolves around gaming, particularly GTA Online, which I've been playing for about a year. I'm largely self-taught, picking up tips from forums, YouTube tutorials, and trial and error. Additionally, my professional experience in graphic design has given me a good eye for aesthetics, which I sometimes apply to in-game modding.
